title: Settings scroll fade — closer to the sides

steps.path: How close the fade gets to the drawer's sides
steps.hint: Scroll inside each drawer to see the fade; scroll outside to reach the next version. Try Meadow Mist, Halftone and a solid theme above.
steps.headline: Which width reaches the sides without looking like a flat strip?
steps.risk: Review-only comparison. Every version stays 42px deep; the middle-strength fade from the last comparison is held constant only to test width, not approved. The title line's 20% taper is also provisional. No production styling has changed.

variants.label: Previous width
variants.summary: A 10% side taper on each edge. Reference for how much content stays visible near the sides.

variants.label: A bit wider
variants.summary: A 7% side taper. The fade reaches closer to the left and right edges.

variants.label: Almost full
variants.summary: A 4% side taper. The fade reaches nearly all the way across, but may feel too rectangular.
